changeSet.author: githubcopilot
changeSet.comment: 将 bytedesk_ai_robot.llm_intent_provider 中历史保存的 provider type 回填为 provider uid，优先匹配同组织 provider，其次回退平台 provider。
changeSet.sql: UPDATE bytedesk_ai_robot r SET r.llm_intent_provider = ( SELECT p.uuid FROM bytedesk_ai_provider p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.provider_type = r.llm_intent_provider AND ( COALESCE(p.org_uid, '') = COALESCE(r.org_uid, '') OR COALESCE(p.org_uid, '') = '' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.org_uid, '') = COALESCE(r.org_uid, '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.id LIMIT 1 ) WHERE r.llm_intent_provider IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bytedesk_ai_provider p0 WHERE p0.uuid = r.llm_intent_provider ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bytedesk_ai_provider p1 WHERE p1.is_deleted = 0 AND p1.provider_type = r.llm_intent_provider AND ( COALESCE(p1.org_uid, '') = COALESCE(r.org_uid, '') OR COALESCE(p1.org_uid, '') = '' ) );

changeSet.comment: PostgreSQL: 将 bytedesk_ai_robot.llm_intent_provider 中历史 provider type 回填为 provider uid。
